title: Measured multi-SOH C/20 pseudo-OCV curves for Samsung INR21700-30T constant-current aging cell
cell: Samsung INR21700-30T, 3.0 Ah, constant-current fast-charge aging protocol
protocol: Repeated 0.05C discharge/charge characterization during aging. Pseudo-OCV is the pointwise mean of measured C/20 discharge and charge voltage at equal normalized SOC.
processing: Curves are selected from the same cell by nearest measured capacity-based SOH. No SOH degradation equation is used. The verified C/20 records span 100% to 74.78% SOH; lower levels are intentionally not fabricated.
